title: Theta Cycles of Modular Forms Modulo $p^2$
summary: The theta cycle of a modular form modulo a prime $p\geq 5$ is well understood. By contrast, the theta cycle modulo a power of $p$ is still mysterious and experimentally erratic. Here we completely determine the theta cycle of a weight $k < p$ modular form modulo $p^2$ on the initial segment of length $p$ and we prove exact values or nontrivial bounds for the weight filtrations on $p-2$ further segments of length $p - k + 1$.
